value.rationale: The rotation-number distribution is a canonical invariant statistic of a positive-area completely integrable annulus. The theorem determines every quantile (piecewise quadratic), the small-rotation density and the sharp moment threshold for winding-time proxy, separating typical rotation rates from infinite expected winding time. The growth law 4K^2-(32/3)K+... quantifies singular behavior as the resonant angle approaches the degenerate endpoint. A single prior polygon area cannot answer these ensemble questions, and no arbitrary cutoff parameter is used.
